title: The arrow endings walk gets a Thickness slider back
goal: One of the scripted walks that photographs the five arrow endings stops halfway through with an empty panel, so nobody can regenerate the pictures that audit uses. Make the walk run to the end again.
notes:
Fails at step 34: press Slider in Thickness reports "the ones that are: none", so the panel had no controls at all, meaning nothing was selected at that point. Confirmed pre-existing on 2026-09-06 by stashing that day's changes and re-running: identical failure at the same step. Likely the arrow drag from [30,250] to [190,250] misses or the preceding escape drops the selection.

Root cause found 2026-09-06: the parts redesign (c72ed55, `next-shape-parts`) took the Thickness row out of the Arrow section entirely. AnnotationInspector.visibleRows now drops `.thickness` when shapePartsEnabled, and the width lives in the parts list as "Width", folded under the chevron of the arrow's stroke row, which for an arrow is titled "Color" (LayerParts.layerPartRows gives a non-switchable outline the title "Color"). So the panel genuinely had no Thickness row and the walk was asking for a control that no longer exists. Nothing was wrong with the drag or the escape.

Fix is in the walk, not the app: press "Settings" in "Color" once to unfold the part, then "Slider" in "Width". Only once, because PartsInspector.openPart is @AppStorage and stays open across selections; `forget: ["panel"]` resets that key, so every run starts folded and the walk is deterministic.
acceptance: Scripts/playtest.sh Scripts/playtest/arrow-endings-walk.json finishes with status ok
The walk still produces the thin row, thick row and caption corner pictures it produced before

log.note: Reproduced first: identical failure at step 34, panel had no row matching "Thickness". Dumped the panel with a one-arrow probe walk: the arrow's controls are Ending, Head Size, Position & Size, a Color row with a Settings chevron, and Effects. No Thickness anywhere.

Traced it to the shape-parts redesign: the width moved into the parts list and was renamed Width, folded behind the Color row's chevron. The walk, not the app, is what needs to change; the title's "gets a Thickness slider back" would mean undoing a deliberate design.

Walk updated and run twice from a clean output folder: status ok, 98 steps both times. Thin row 4pt, thick row 13pt (plain line grows 4->14 tall, open head 36->46), and the pill/badge/square caption shot is back. Scripts/test.sh green, 4139 tests.
Adversarial pass on the built thing: making an arrow thicker is now two clicks behind a row named Color, which says nothing about line width. Filed as its own task rather than changed here.

Scripts/playtest/arrow-endings-walk.json now unfolds the Color part and pulls Width, where the shape-parts redesign moved the arrow's thickness. Two clean runs, status ok, 98 steps; thin row 4pt, thick row 13pt, caption corners picture back. Scripts/test.sh green. Committed 6f848a4.
